_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (26 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 and formed the Cabinet on 29 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.next_elections: 2027-05 (Barnsley elects by thirds; next scheduled all-out under review)
administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (42 of 63), ending Labour control held since 1974. Leader Cllr William Brown; Deputy Cllr Edward Dillingham. Portfolios are titled 'Cabinet Spokesperson for...'. Part of the South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority (Mayor Oliver Coppard, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no EFS, no Best Value Notice; described as a strong financial position). DSG High Needs deficit ~GBP 19.3m (end March 2026); pursuing a High Needs Stability Grant.
mtfs._source: Barnsley MBC 2026/27 MTFS (doc s132196), full Council 26 Feb 2026, pulled and read directly.
